reviews.text: My dog has been groomed at the groom room since a puppy. The service is exceptional and he always looks amazing when finished. The groomers are lovely and very professional. I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Meredith had been grooming my dog Daisy  for 7 years without an issue Always a great cut and Daisy seemed to enjoy going there However since Meredith left and they have moved the groomers from the now closed Newton Mearns store they did not listen to how I wanted her cut and the last 2 cuts were a mess and Daisy seemed stressed afterwards Will not be back
Sponsored showing up as an irrelevant result. One star.
I've a nervous whippet who hates getting her nails clipped but the staff were great and it was all done in 5 minutes. Will definitely be back.
Fantastic team, amazing job of a nervous dog. Looks fabulous, would totally recommend.
The ladies who work here are pure gold. They really love dogs and know our girl by name and remember details about her. They're kind and lovivg and exactly who you'd want to leave your doggie with.
The girls are great with Dottie and our late poppy!
